deities: Kali (worshipped as Sevokeshwari, 'the Goddess of Sevoke')

history.period: Unknown - no reliable founding date; one directory listing claims 'serving since 1730' (weak claim - verify)
history.summary: The Sevokeshwari Kali Mandir (Sevoke Kalibari) near the Coronation Bridge on the Teesta river at Sevoke, on Sevoke Road (NH 31A), about 20-23 km northeast of Siliguri. The black-stone Kali idol is considered highly powerful; passing drivers stop for blessings; the site also offers Kanchenjunga views, with Baba Lokenath and Shiva shrines inside the temple building. CSV TOWN FLAG: CSV town 'Siliguri' is approximate - the temple is at Sevoke, not in Siliguri town. HISTORY FLAG: no founding history is reliably documented; the '1730' claim on one listing is uncorroborated. COORDINATES are a geocoder POI match ('Shiv Kali Mata Mandir, Sevoke Road') with only moderate relevance - approximate, verify. Open 24 hours per listings (verify).

name: Sevokeshwari Kali Mandir
town: Sevoke (CSV town 'Siliguri' is approximate - about 22 km away)
town_description: Sevoke (Sebok) is a small town on the Teesta river about 22-23 km northeast of Siliguri on NH 31A, in the foothills of the Himalayas. It is known for the Coronation Bridge, the Sevokeshwari Kali Mandir, and as the gateway route toward Kalimpong, Gangtok and Sikkim.

travel.road: On Sevoke Road (NH 31A), about 20-23 km from Siliguri town centre, near the Coronation Bridge; taxis and auto-rickshaws available

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Navratri, Durga Puja and Kali Puja are the busiest periods
visitor_information.opening_hours: Listed as open 24 hours on directory listings (verify - directory claims are unreliable)
